deposit.refused.notANumber: That is not an amount. Type digits with a point for decimals, for example 12.5.
deposit.refused.negative: An amount cannot be below nothing. Type an amount above nothing.
deposit.refused.zero: An amount of nothing is not a deposit. Type an amount above nothing, or press Max.
deposit.refused.tooManyDecimals: That has more decimal places than this token has. Remove the extra digits.
deposit.refused.groupSeparator: Type the amount without spaces or commas between the digits, for example 1200.5.

deposit.walletMakes: Your wallet is making the deposit: it proves it, pays it, hands it to this page to send, and records it once the network shows it.
deposit.done: Done. The network shows this deposit in the vault.
deposit.done.transaction: The network shows it in this transaction:
deposit.done.notNamed: The deposit is in the vault. This page has not yet matched it to its transaction.
deposit.done.notSpendable: It cannot be used for a payment yet. Check the vault again in a minute.
deposit.done.earlierRecorded: An earlier deposit from this browser was also found in the vault, and is now recorded.
deposit.done.earlierNeverLanded: An earlier deposit from this browser never reached the vault. No money moved for it.
deposit.failed.maybeSent: Putting money in did not finish. Before you try again, press Check my last deposit to see whether anything reached the vault. Details for support: {reasons}.
deposit.failed.publicMaybeSent: This public deposit may have been sent, and this page was not told whether it arrived. Do not put the same money in again before {when}. If it has not arrived by then, it never will. Open your wallet: if its public balance has dropped by this amount and you spent nothing else from it, the vault has it. "Check my last deposit" finds only private deposits, so it cannot tell you about this one.
deposit.failed.publicMaybeSentNoTime: This public deposit may have been sent, and this page was not told whether it arrived. Do not put the same money in again until you have looked at your wallet: if its public balance has dropped by this amount and you spent nothing else from it, the vault has it. "Check my last deposit" finds only private deposits, so it cannot tell you about this one.
deposit.failed.nothingSent: Nothing was sent to the network, so no money moved.
deposit.check.privateOnly: This checks the newest private deposit filed for this vault, and one this browser kept from before your wallet made deposits. A public deposit is checked in your wallet, not here.
deposit.check.nothingWaiting: This browser has no deposit into this vault waiting to be seen.
deposit.check.alreadyRecorded: The deposit checked is already in the vault's record.
deposit.check.neverLanded: Your last deposit from this browser never reached the vault, and now it never will. No money moved.
deposit.check.recorded: Your last deposit from this browser has reached the vault and is now in its record.
deposit.check.notSpendable: It cannot be used for a payment yet.
deposit.check.stillOnItsWay: Your last deposit from this browser has not reached the vault yet. If it has not arrived by {when}, it never will and no money moved. Do not put the same money in again.
deposit.check.owedItsRecord: The deposit is in the vault, and not yet in its record. The vault's deposit journal names it, so it is not lost; a check here files nothing. Do not put the same money in again.
deposit.check.journalledNotSeen: The newest deposit filed for this vault has not reached the vault yet. It may still arrive. Do not put the same money in again.
deposit.check.landedAndSinceSpent: The deposit reached the vault, and the vault has since paid it out or combined it.
deposit.check.landedNotRecorded: Your last deposit from this browser is in the vault, and this page cannot yet read the transfer that brought it in. Check again in a minute.
deposit.check.unnamed_one: {count} deposit in the vault is not yet matched to its transaction.
deposit.check.unnamed_other: {count} deposits in the vault are not yet matched to their transactions.
deposit.check.toName_one: {count} deposit in the vault can be used for payments once a signer's wallet next files this vault's records.
deposit.check.toName_other: {count} deposits in the vault can be used for payments once a signer's wallet next files this vault's records.
vault.publicMoney.unreadable: What this vault holds publicly could not be read. Use the refresh button above the table to try again. If it still fails, contact support.
vault.payouts.none: No payroll run pays out of this vault yet.
